headline: AFIS summit in Luanda addresses redirection of African banking capital
summary: At the AFIS 2026 summit in Luanda, financial leaders discussed how African institutions can direct $100 billion in banking profits away from dollar-denominated debt and into the real economy.
why: Shifting institutional capital allocation from foreign currency debt to domestic productive assets is vital for long-term economic growth and currency stability across African markets.

impacts.name: African Banking Sector
impacts.why: Financial institutions are discussing strategic shifts in capital allocation.
